title: Get rid of the global
description:
`applyDiscount` reads and changes a global variable. That makes it hard to test and easy to break: any other function could change `g_price` behind its back.

Rewrite it as a function that takes what it needs as **parameters** and **returns** its answer:

`double applyDiscount(double price, double percent)`

For a price of 200 and 15 percent it returns 170. There must be no global variable left.
